NETWORK.NAME: AggressionClozapine_R6_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

drafting_lead=BNs/BN-09.xml inference-disabled draft; nodes, states and edges retained verbatim; missing root priors added and deterministic 0-1 workflow tables replaced with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each deterministic argmax

VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaEstablished
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia. No means assessed and not confirmed; not missing diagnostic data
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: SubstantialAggressionRisk
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician judgment of substantial current risk for aggressive behavior with recorded date, behavior and threat history, current symptoms and context, instrument name/version and observation window if used, and rationale. PANSS hostility item (P7, 1-7) or any scale score alone never establishes the gate; No does not mean zero risk
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: AggressionRiskPersistsDespiteOtherTreatments
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Aggression Risk Persists Despite Other Treatments

definition=Clinician documents that substantial aggression risk persists despite other treatments, with reviewed treatments, dates, response and adherence evidence. No means assessed criterion not met. NOT two failed antipsychotic trials and NOT treatment resistance
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician identifies a need for urgent safety assessment or intervention, including immediate danger to others or self, or serious suspected treatment harm. Present triggers the deterministic urgent flag without waiting for any LLM output. Absent means assessed and not identified, never missing assessment, and never a guarantee of safety
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute Absent for absent documentation
source_locator=Implementation; Balancing of Potential Benefits and Harms in Rating the Strength of the Guideline Statement / Harms

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=A documented adherence problem or uncertainty about actual exposure needs clinical review. This affirmative concern is distinct from entirely missing adherence assessment
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: ModifiableAggressionRiskTargetsPresent
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician identifies potentially modifiable aggression-risk factors requiring treatment-plan attention, such as substance use, relevant psychotic symptoms or anger/impulsivity in individual context. No means assessed and none identified. No checklist or demographic factor mechanically determines aggression risk
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineTreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; otherwise distinguish past exposure from never treated. Prior exposure requires individualized benefit/harm and discontinuation-history review. Status only; no dose, duration, route or frequency per FR-14
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute a status for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: WillingToDiscussClozapine
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Patient currently willing to discuss clozapine; this is not consent to treatment. No prompts exploration of concerns and preferences, not removal of the indication
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineMonitoringPlanAvailable
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=A feasible clinician-reviewed monitoring and follow-up plan is available, including ANC and relevant cardiac, bowel, metabolic and other adverse-effect surveillance per current local guidance. No means a documented planning/logistical gap, not an absolute contraindication
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineMedicalReviewCompleted
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current clinician or pharmacist benefit-harm, contraindication and interaction review is documented. Yes means review performed, not that clozapine is safe or appropriate to prescribe. The review conclusion remains a clinician responsibility
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation
source_locator=Balancing of Benefits and Harms; Harms

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineAggressionRiskIndication
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Documented schizophrenia plus substantial aggression risk persisting despite other treatments. NotEstablished does not rule out clozapine for other indications. Formal treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute NotEstablished for absent documentation
source_locator=STATEMENT 9: Clozapine in Aggressive Behavior; Implementation

VARIABLE.NAME: AggressionRiskTreatmentPlanReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Independent review needs; never a prerequisite that delays indicated clozapine discussion or urgent care. NoAdditionalFlag means neither modeled concern was flagged, not that the treatment plan is complete
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute NoAdditionalFlag for absent documentation

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineDiscussionPreparation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Address preference concerns, monitoring access or an unfinished medical review. PreparedForDiscussion never means medical clearance or treatment consent
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute PreparedForDiscussion for absent documentation
source_locator=Patient Preferences; Balancing of Benefits and Harms

VARIABLE.NAME: AggressionRiskClozapineReviewPathway
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Proposed workflow with urgent assessment first. Current or prior clozapine branches preserve the separate indication flag and require clinician interpretation; no branch authorizes starting, restarting, continuing or stopping treatment
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute a pathway state for absent documentation
source_locator=Implementation; Patient Preferences; Quality Measurement Considerations
